hero.title: State of Efficiency.
hero.lead: A state that works. A state in which administration simply runs.
hero.sub: Bureaucracy. Automated. With agentic AI that you train like a new employee.

meanings.title: One name, two promises.

items.title: A state that works.
items.text: Agencies and associations carry enormous responsibility and enormous piles of files. SOE takes over the routine so that experts have time for people and for the hard cases.

items.title: A state in which things run.
items.text: Efficiency is not a project with an end date, it is a state: no backlogs, no media breaks, every step traceable.

meanings.closing: We put the state into a state of efficiency.

soe.title: SOE learns like a new colleague.
soe.text: SOE, the initials of State of Efficiency, is the agent on our platform. You explain your process to it in conversation, just as you would show it to a new employee. SOE turns that into the workflow.

steps.title: In conversation, not in a form
steps.text: You describe the process in your own words. SOE asks where something is unclear and lets you show examples.

steps.title: The workflow takes shape step by step
steps.text: SOE lays out every step visibly. You correct it directly, and each correction becomes part of the rules.

steps.title: The agent works, your team decides
steps.text: SOE processes the cases. At the checkpoints you define, your team approves.

chat.text: For grant applications, first check that all documents are complete. Then check the deadlines.
Understood. What should happen if a document is missing?
Then ask for it in writing and set a deadline of 14 days.

items.title: Workflows in dialogue
items.text: Processes emerge in conversation with SOE, not in project plans and requirement documents.

items.title: One platform for every process
items.text: From application to decision: one place where workflows are built, operated and improved.

items.title: Approval at checkpoints
items.text: You decide where a human makes the call. The rest runs by itself.

items.title: Fully traceable
items.text: Every step, every source and every decision is logged and open to inspection.

items.title: Connected to your systems
items.text: SOE works with your specialist applications and document stores. We clarify the scope in the first call.

items.title: Knowledge stays in the house
items.text: Your team's corrections flow into the rules. What lives in a few heads today is documented afterwards.

security.title: Agents need supervision.
security.text: An agent you cannot trust saves no work. That is why control is not an add-on, it is part of every run.

guard.title: Errors and hallucinations are detected and fixed.
guard.text: Every run is checked for unsupported claims, wrong tool calls and deviations from your process instructions. Problems are caught mid-run: the answer is corrected, or the step goes to a human for approval.
points: Statements are checked against your documents
Correction or escalation before an error reaches the case

mock.fixed: Corrected before the draft is created

space.title: Every agent gets its own sealed-off workspace.
space.text: The agent works in an isolated environment and may only do what you allow. Everything else stays blocked.
points: Isolated environment and minimal access rights
Network rules: only approved systems are reachable
Approval for sensitive actions and a complete audit log

data.title: Processed on servers in Germany.
data.text: We process the data of your processes exclusively on German servers, in line with the requirements of ISO 27001 and GDPR.
data.proof: Required security and GDPR certifications and evidence are available on request.

team.title: Your team loses the routine, not the role.
team.text: SOE takes over what repeats. Exceptions, hardship cases and conversations with people stay with your experts.

items.q: What happens if the agent states something wrong?
items.a: No system is free of errors. That is why error control checks every run against your sources. Unsupported statements are detected and corrected, or passed to a human, before they reach the case.
Your team. You define where a human reviews and approves. SOE prepares and documents.
We process the data of your processes exclusively on German servers, in line with the requirements of ISO 27001 and GDPR.
Required security and GDPR certifications and evidence are available on request. Request evidence.

items.q: Can SOE connect to our systems?
items.a: SOE is connected to your existing specialist applications and document stores. Which systems and how, we clarify together in the first call.
With a single process. We build the agent together with you, you train it, and from there the platform grows with your requirements.

cta.title: Change the state of things. Let's talk.
cta.text: Show us your processes. In a first call we assess which of them an agent can automate, and we build it together with you.

about.title: People who know the state from the inside.
about.text: We have worked in a federal ministry, led civil society organisations and built AI tools for federal ministries. State of Efficiency grew out of both: we put the state into a state of efficiency.

people.name: Raphael Cuadros
people.summary: Raphael knows the state from the inside. At the Federal Ministry for Family Affairs he coordinated funding and supervision and saw how decisions in a public authority actually come about: between departments, staff representation and political responsibility. In leadership roles at the Child Protection Association in Berlin and at Sea-Watch e.V. he led organisations, gave complex work a clear structure and mediated between administration, politics and teams. That combination of inside knowledge, organisation and clear communication is what it takes to build secure AI agents for public institutions.

people.name: Timo Möller
people.tagline: Secure AI for government and industry
people.summary: Timo builds secure AI products for German and European public institutions and for industry. As co-founder of deepset he developed AI tooling for federal ministries. He has extensive experience delivering security-certified SaaS applications as well as tightly sealed, high-security on-premise systems. That is how agents are built to meet the demands of government: traceable, secured, and connected to the systems already in place.

p: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is:

This website is served via GitHub Pages (GitHub Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA). When you visit the pages, the hosting provider processes technically necessary connection data in server log files, in particular your IP address and the date and time of access. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest is the secure and efficient delivery of this website.
This may involve a transfer to the USA. To our knowledge, GitHub participates in the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
The fonts used are delivered by this website itself. No connection to font provider servers is established.

If you contact us by email, we process the data you provide (for example name, email address and message content) to answer your request. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR. The contact form on this website only opens your email program. The entries are neither transmitted nor stored by the website.

This website uses no cookies and no tracking or web analytics. Your chosen language (de or en) is stored only locally in your browser so that we can send you to the matching version on your next visit. This information is not transmitted to us.

You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection regarding the processing of your personal data. To exercise them, contact the address above.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, for example the Berlin Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information.
